meta.name: Quantum Explorer
meta.longDescription: Quantum Explorer tracks Dogecoin post-quantum transaction signals in realtime from pure P2P mempool gossip and confirms transaction visibility through SPV logs. Public users can search by Dogecoin address, txid, block height/hash text, and see latest PQ activity with pending/confirmed + PQ-validity indicators. Admin controls are token-gated on the same web port via /admin/<TOKEN> and /api/admin/<TOKEN>/* for mempool/SPV start-stop and checkpoint metadata. Default checkpoint: block 6150000, hash 9e8f55907f17dc4870cdc9e6ea75236782190c13c10a8126baea3b1da94593c5, timestamp 2026-04-03T03:16:25Z.
